name: Ibn Arabi (Muhyiddin Ibn 'Arabi)
shortBio: Andalusian master philosopher and mystic known as 'Al-Shaykh al-Akbar'; formulated the doctrine of the Unity of Being (Wahdat al-Wujud) and the imaginal realm ('alam al-mithal).
centralQuestion: How does the singular transcendent Reality manifest as the kaleidoscopic multiplicity of the cosmos through divine self-disclosure?

keyWorks.title: The Bezels of Wisdom (Fusus al-Hikam)
keyWorks.description: Quintessential exposition of the divine attributes, prophetic wisdoms, and the non-dual reality of Wujud.

keyWorks.title: The Meccan Revelations (Al-Futuhat al-Makkiyya)
keyWorks.description: Monumental encyclopedia of mystical metaphysics, cosmogony, spiritual psychology, and hermeneutics.
